root: ^Petra opens a ledger. "Your name, your belongings. No one else's account touches yours."
^Is my gold safe if I fall in Alby?

c-0: ^"I can hold sixty item slots and your gold. Choose exactly how much to deposit or withdraw. Worn weapons keep their condition in storage."
c-1: ^"Unequip it here in town first. If your pack is full, make room before you take anything out. I never accept half a transfer."
c-2: ^"Yes. Neither your banked gold nor the gold you carry is lost on defeat. Elara will see you home."
